description: Main source file for a Flutter-based Tic Tac Toe app with a custom Ocean Professional theme. Contains theme setup, user interface components including home screen, game screen, game logic, and UI widgets.

classes.name: TicTacToeApp
classes.description: Root widget setting up the MaterialApp with custom theme and home screen.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Initial screen allowing user to select game mode (vs Player or vs Computer).

classes.name: _ModeCard
classes.description: Interactive card widget for mode selection with animated press effect.

classes.name: GameScreen
classes.description: Main game screen managing game state, user interactions, AI moves, and game flow.

classes.name: _TurnIndicator
classes.description: Widget displaying current turn status with highlight effects.

classes.name: _PlayerChip
classes.description: Stylized indicator for player turn highlighting.

classes.name: _ScoreBar
classes.description: Displays current scores for X wins, O wins, and draws.

classes.name: _Board
classes.description: Grid of game cells; managing tap interactions and rendering cells.

classes.name: _BoardCell
classes.description: Represents individual cell with animation and tap handling.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initializes and runs the app.

methods.name: _buildTheme
methods.description: Builds custom Material 3 theme for the app.

methods.name: _startGame
methods.description: Navigates to the game screen with selected mode.

methods.name: _onCellTap
methods.description: Handles user tap on a game cell, updating game state.

methods.name: _evaluateBoardAndMaybeContinue
methods.description: Checks for win/draw and updates game state, possibly triggering AI move.

methods.name: _makeComputerMove
methods.description: Executes AI's move based on simple heuristic.

methods.name: _detectWinner
methods.description: Detects if there is a winner in the given board state.

methods.name: _isBoardFull
methods.description: Checks if the game board is completely filled.

methods.name: _showEndDialog
methods.description: Displays dialog at game end with options to restart or go home.

methods.name: _chooseBestAIMove
methods.description: AI heuristic to select the next move—attempts to win, block, or pick strategic positions.
